requirements.title: Operational envelope
requirements.statement: The system shall define approved missions, actors, operating modes and environmental limits for each configuration.
requirements.acceptance: Review mission scenarios, boundaries and measurable envelope; no unresolved operating limit at release.
requirements.source: Transferred COM baseline from jfxai4mass; allocated to ARM and HAT configurations in jfxai4rffs

requirements.title: Module interoperability
requirements.statement: The system shall provide versioned mechanical, power and data interface contracts for interchangeable modules.
requirements.acceptance: Demonstrate module substitution against interface contracts, including incompatible-module rejection.
requirements.source: Transferred COM baseline from jfxai4mass; allocated to ARM and HAT configurations in jfxai4rffs

requirements.title: Local fault response
requirements.statement: The system shall execute a defined local safe or degraded response to each identified critical fault.
requirements.acceptance: Inject critical faults and connectivity loss; measured response meets the approved fault-response matrix.
requirements.source: Transferred COM baseline from jfxai4mass; allocated to ARM and HAT configurations in jfxai4rffs

requirements.title: Energy provision
requirements.statement: The system shall supply mission and essential safety loads within the approved energy budget.
requirements.acceptance: Analyze and test worst-case coincident loads and reserve against the configured mission profile.
requirements.source: Transferred COM baseline from jfxai4mass; allocated to ARM and HAT configurations in jfxai4rffs

requirements.title: Twin identity and provenance
requirements.statement: The digital twin shall associate each state record with asset identity, configuration, timestamp, source and validity.
requirements.acceptance: Replay records and reject or flag stale, missing and mismatched states according to the data contract.
requirements.source: Transferred COM baseline from jfxai4mass; allocated to ARM and HAT configurations in jfxai4rffs

requirements.title: Model verification
requirements.statement: The project shall maintain versioned executable models and reproducible scenarios for each claimed system capability.
requirements.acceptance: Reproduce model runs and correlate selected outputs with bench or prototype data within approved tolerances.
requirements.source: Transferred COM baseline from jfxai4mass; allocated to ARM and HAT configurations in jfxai4rffs

requirements.title: Maintenance access
requirements.statement: The system shall provide documented inspection and replacement procedures for serviceable modules.
requirements.acceptance: Demonstrate inspection and replacement using approved tools, isolation steps and service limits.
requirements.source: Transferred COM baseline from jfxai4mass; allocated to ARM and HAT configurations in jfxai4rffs

requirements.title: Command authorization
requirements.statement: The system shall accept control commands only from authenticated and authorized sources.
requirements.acceptance: Test unauthorized, replayed and malformed commands; verify rejection and event recording.
requirements.source: Transferred COM baseline from jfxai4mass; allocated to ARM and HAT configurations in jfxai4rffs

requirements.title: Configuration traceability
requirements.statement: The project shall trace each requirement to its allocated element, verification result and released configuration.
requirements.acceptance: Audit complete requirement-to-evidence links and disposition of failures before baseline release.
requirements.source: Transferred COM baseline from jfxai4mass; allocated to ARM and HAT configurations in jfxai4rffs

requirements.title: Ground mobility
requirements.statement: The vehicle shall provide propulsion, steering and braking throughout its approved terrain and loading envelope.
requirements.acceptance: Analyze and test handling, braking and grade performance for the worst approved payload and panel configuration.

requirements.title: Panel interchange
requirements.statement: The vehicle shall permit replacement of designated protective panels through documented mounting interfaces.
requirements.acceptance: Demonstrate panel exchange, correct installation and retention under approved structural loads.

requirements.title: Protection objective
requirements.statement: The project shall specify a threat and protection acceptance basis for each claimed protective configuration.
requirements.acceptance: Approve threat cases and assembly-level evaluation plan; close performance evidence before making protection claims.

requirements.title: Occupant egress
requirements.statement: The vehicle shall provide occupant emergency egress in each approved occupied configuration.
requirements.acceptance: Demonstrate access and emergency exit with representative occupants and equipment under defined fault cases.

requirements.title: Payload retention
requirements.statement: The vehicle shall retain cargo and installed modules under the approved service and emergency load cases.
requirements.acceptance: Analyze and test mounts with representative payloads and configuration-specific mass and center of gravity.

requirements.title: Condition monitoring
requirements.statement: The system shall report the health of monitored vehicle and protective modules with their configuration identity.
requirements.acceptance: Introduce monitored faults and verify detection, operator indication and twin association.

requirements.title: Mission and loading envelope
requirements.statement: The aircraft concept shall define cargo, crew, mass/CG, ground, flight and water operating envelopes.
requirements.acceptance: Review configuration-specific payload, mass/CG and environmental limits before model verification.

requirements.title: Airframe and cargo retention
requirements.statement: The airframe, floats and cargo restraints shall withstand the selected operational and emergency load cases.
requirements.acceptance: Analyze structure, float attachments and cargo retention against approved load cases.

requirements.title: Flight dynamics
requirements.statement: The configured aircraft shall meet defined aerodynamic, propulsion and handling targets.
requirements.acceptance: Run reproducible aerodynamic and flight-dynamics cases with fixed geometry and mass/CG; correlate before physical claims.

requirements.title: Flotation and water transition
requirements.statement: The twin-float configuration shall meet approved buoyancy, stability and water-transition criteria.
requirements.acceptance: Analyze displacement, trim, stability and hydrodynamic loads for each loading case; evaluate transition guards.

requirements.title: Gaseous hydrogen isolation
requirements.statement: The energy configuration shall model gaseous hydrogen storage, leak detection, ventilation and isolation.
requirements.acceptance: Review tank packaging and hazard cases; inject leak and sensor faults into an isolated model and verify local response.

requirements.title: Hybrid energy and cooling
requirements.statement: The fuel-cell and buffer-battery system shall supply propulsion and essential loads within its approved power, thermal and reserve budgets.
requirements.acceptance: Reproduce mission energy and cooling cases including fuel-cell loss and battery limits.

requirements.title: Supervised mission interfaces
requirements.statement: The concept twin shall exchange versioned mission, cargo and state records with the instructor and robotic-training services.
requirements.acceptance: Replay authorized, stale and conflicting commands; verify local authority and asset/configuration identity.

requirements.title: Occupant and recovery scenarios
requirements.statement: The concept shall define access, emergency egress and recovery scenarios for each occupied configuration.
requirements.acceptance: Review access and evacuation scenarios against defined occupants, cargo and ground/water conditions.
